test_cases.title: Full refund of a Visa sale returns money to the same Visa card
preconditions: Store 0412 POS is online
Sale TXN-2001 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Wireless Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $40.00; refund receipt shows tender Visa ending 4242; no cash or store credit issued

test_cases.title: Full refund of a cash sale is returned as cash
preconditions: Sale TXN-2002 on 2026-10-22: 1 x USB-C Cable (SKU 100567) $19.00, paid in cash
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $19.00; refund receipt shows tender Cash; cash drawer opens; no card refund or store credit issued

test_cases.title: Cashier cannot redirect a Visa sale refund to cash
preconditions: Sale TXN-2003 on 2026-10-21: 1 x Phone Case (SKU 100890) $35.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 3. Try to select Cash as the refund tender
test_cases.expected: POS does not allow Cash as the refund tender; $35.00 is refunded to Visa ending 4242; cash drawer does not open

test_cases.title: Refund allowed for a sale made 10 days ago
preconditions: Today is 2026-10-28
Sale TXN-2004 on 2026-10-18: 1 x Keyboard (SKU 100311) $89.00, paid by Mastercard ending 5454 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $89.00 to Mastercard ending 5454

test_cases.title: Refund blocked for a sale made 45 days ago
preconditions: Today is 2026-10-28
Sale TXN-2005 on 2026-09-13: 1 x Keyboard (SKU 100311) $89.00, paid by Mastercard ending 5454 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund and shows it is outside the refund window; no money is refunded to any tender; no store credit issued

test_cases.title: Refund allowed on day 30 after purchase
preconditions: Today is 2026-10-28
Sale TXN-2006 on 2026-09-28: 1 x Headphones (SKU 100420) $120.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $120.00 to Visa ending 4242 (see open question on whether day 30 is inclusive)

test_cases.title: Refund blocked on day 31 after purchase
preconditions: Today is 2026-10-28
Sale TXN-2007 on 2026-09-27: 1 x Headphones (SKU 100420) $120.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund and shows it is outside the refund window; no money is refunded to any tender

test_cases.title: Full refund of a split-tender sale refunds the last tender first
preconditions: Sale TXN-2008 on 2026-10-24: 1 x Smart Speaker (SKU 100777) $100.00
Payment 1: Gift Card GC-8801 $60.00; Payment 2: Visa ending 4242 (active) $40.00
test_cases.expected: Refund receipt and transaction log list Visa ending 4242 $40.00 first, then Gift Card GC-8801 $60.00; total refunded $100.00

test_cases.title: Partial refund smaller than the last tender goes entirely to the last tender
preconditions: Payment 1: Gift Card GC-8802 $60.00; Payment 2: Visa ending 4242 (active) $40.00
test_cases.expected: $30.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242; $0.00 to Gift Card GC-8802

test_cases.title: Partial refund larger than the last tender spills over to the previous tender
preconditions: Payment 1: Gift Card GC-8803 $60.00; Payment 2: Visa ending 4242 (active) $40.00
test_cases.expected: $40.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242 and $10.00 refunded to Gift Card GC-8803; total $50.00

test_cases.title: Cashier cannot override reverse-order allocation on a split-tender refund
preconditions: Payment 1: Visa ending 4242 (active) $60.00; Payment 2: Cash $40.00
steps: 3. Try to allocate the refund to Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS does not allow the manual allocation; $30.00 is refunded as Cash (last tender); $0.00 to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: Single line item can be refunded from a multi-item sale
preconditions: Sale TXN-2012 on 2026-10-25: Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, Cable (SKU 100567) $40.00, Stand (SKU 100600) $40.00 = $120.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: $40.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242; Mouse and Stand remain refundable on TXN-2012

test_cases.title: Same line item cannot be refunded twice
preconditions: Sale TXN-2013 on 2026-10-25: Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, Cable (SKU 100567) $40.00, Stand (SKU 100600) $40.00 = $120.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
Cable (SKU 100567) already refunded $40.00 on 2026-10-26
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund for Cable; no additional money is refunded; cumulative refunded amount for TXN-2013 stays $40.00

test_cases.title: Cumulative partial refunds equal to the original amount are allowed, then any further refund is blocked
preconditions: Sale TXN-2014 on 2026-10-25: Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, Cable (SKU 100567) $40.00, Stand (SKU 100600) $40.00 = $120.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 4. Scan receipt for TXN-2014 and try to start another refund
test_cases.expected: Steps 1-3 each approved; cumulative refunded = $120.00 to Visa ending 4242; step 4 is blocked and no further money is refunded

test_cases.title: Refund of $650 is processed after manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2015 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Monitor (SKU 100900) $650.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
Manager ID MGR-77 available at the register
steps: 3. When prompted, manager MGR-77 approves at the register
test_cases.expected: POS shows manager approval prompt at step 3; after approval, $650.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: Refund of $650 is not processed when manager declines approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2016 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Monitor (SKU 100900) $650.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
Manager ID MGR-77 available at the register
test_cases.expected: POS does not complete the refund; $0.00 refunded to any tender; TXN-2016 remains fully refundable

test_cases.title: Refund of exactly $500.00 does not require manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2017 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Tablet (SKU 100950) $500.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: No manager approval prompt shown; $500.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: Refund of $500.01 requires manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2018 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Tablet (SKU 100951) $500.01, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
test_cases.expected: POS shows manager approval prompt before the refund can be confirmed; no money refunded until approval is given

test_cases.title: Refund to an expired card is issued as store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2019 on 2026-10-01: 1 x Speaker (SKU 100700) $75.00, paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Mastercard ending 5454 expired 2026-10-15
test_cases.expected: POS issues $75.00 as store credit; store credit number printed on refund receipt; $0.00 refunded to Mastercard ending 5454

test_cases.title: Refund to a closed card is issued as store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2020 on 2026-10-05: 1 x Speaker (SKU 100700) $75.00, paid by Visa ending 1111
Visa ending 1111 account is closed
test_cases.expected: POS issues $75.00 as store credit; $0.00 refunded to Visa ending 1111

test_cases.title: Refund to an active card is not converted to store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2021 on 2026-10-05: 1 x Speaker (SKU 100700) $75.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active, not expired)
test_cases.expected: $75.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242; no store credit issued

test_cases.title: SAP refund message contains all six required fields with correct values
preconditions: SAP endpoint is up and message capture is enabled
Sale TXN-2022 on 2026-10-20 at Store 0412: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 3. Confirm refund and note the refundId on the receipt
4. Open the captured SAP refund message
test_cases.expected: SAP message contains refundId = value on receipt, originalTxnId = TXN-2022, amount = 40.00, tenderType = Visa, storeId = 0412, timestamp present; no field missing or empty

test_cases.title: SAP refund message is received within 5 minutes of refund completion
preconditions: SAP endpoint is up and message capture records receive time
Sale TXN-2023 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Cable (SKU 100567) $19.00, paid in cash
steps: 3. Confirm refund and record the completion time on the refund receipt
4. Record the SAP receive time of the refund message
test_cases.expected: SAP receive time minus refund completion time is 5:00 minutes or less

test_cases.title: No SAP refund message is sent when the refund is cancelled before confirmation
preconditions: SAP endpoint is up and message capture is enabled
Sale TXN-2024 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 4. Wait 6 minutes and check captured SAP messages
test_cases.expected: No SAP refund message with originalTxnId = TXN-2024 is received; $0.00 refunded

test_cases.title: SAP send succeeds on first retry and no error log is written
preconditions: SAP endpoint stub returns HTTP 503 on the 1st call, then HTTP 200
Sale TXN-2025 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2025 in full and confirm
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows 2 calls (1 initial + 1 retry); message accepted; no error log entry for this refund

test_cases.title: SAP send succeeds on the 3rd retry and no error log is written
preconditions: SAP endpoint stub returns HTTP 503 on calls 1-3, then HTTP 200 on call 4
Sale TXN-2026 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2026 in full and confirm
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows 4 calls (1 initial + 3 retries); message accepted on call 4; no error log entry for this refund

test_cases.title: After 3 failed retries POS stops retrying and writes one error log entry
preconditions: SAP endpoint stub returns HTTP 503 on every call
Sale TXN-2027 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2027 in full and confirm
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows exactly 4 calls (1 initial + 3 retries), no 5th call; POS error log has exactly one entry for this refund

test_cases.title: No retries and no error log when the first SAP send succeeds
preconditions: SAP endpoint stub returns HTTP 200 on every call
Sale TXN-2028 on 2026-10-20: 1 x Mouse (SKU 100234) $40.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 (active)
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2028 in full and confirm
test_cases.expected: SAP stub shows exactly 1 call; no error log entry for this refund

open_questions: R2: Is day 30 inclusive? Is the window counted in calendar days, and in which time zone (store local or server)?
R2: What exact message should the POS show when a refund is outside the 30-day window?
R2/R4: Are no-receipt refunds in scope?
R3: Does reverse order apply per refund (each partial refund starts again from the last tender) or across all refunds on the same sale (tenders already refunded are skipped)?
R3/R6: In a split-tender sale where one card is expired or closed, is only that card's portion issued as store credit?
R4: How are tax, discounts and promotions split when only one line item is refunded?
R5: Is the $500 limit checked against the refund amount or the original sale amount? Is it per refund or cumulative across partial refunds on the same sale?
R5: Confirm that exactly $500.00 does NOT need approval ('over $500').
R5: What happens if a manager declines or the approval times out? Can the cashier retry the approval?
R6: How does the POS detect a closed card (processor decline code, real-time check)? Which response codes count as 'closed'?
R7: Is the 5 minutes measured from refund confirmation, receipt print or something else? What formats are required for amount and timestamp?
R7: For a split-tender refund, is one SAP message sent per tender, or one message with multiple tenderTypes?
R7: Is store credit sent to SAP with a specific tenderType value?
R8: Does '3 retries' mean 4 total attempts (1 initial + 3 retries)? What is the interval between retries, and must all retries finish within the 5-minute window?
R8: Where is the error log written and what fields must the entry contain? Is the refund still completed for the customer when SAP fails?
